app.name: Kith
app.description: A quiet place to read, listen, remember, and share living traditions.
app.heroLede: A multilingual home for devotion, culture and living heritage — read carefully published writing, listen to voices, mark sacred time, and find the communities that keep these traditions.

home.title: Discover what gives life meaning.
home.body: A multilingual space to preserve heritage, publish carefully, and follow the traditions that matter to you.
home.scopedFeed: Stories filtered through your active lens.
home.openFeed: Stories, articles, and voices from across traditions.
home.emptyFeed: Nothing in your river yet. Follow a tradition or explore to discover voices.
home.featuredHint: Long-form writing and voices from the community.
home.todayHint: Short listens and readings close to your language and area.
home.inviteBody: Create invitations for services, gatherings, festivals, and community events.

explore.title: Explore
explore.lede: Browse religions, traditions, sacred figures, topics, regions, and languages. All lists load through the scope service.
explore.categoriesHint: Each dimension opens a curated path into articles, media, and community voices.
explore.itemCount: {count, plural, =0 {No entries yet} one {# entry} other {# entries}}
explore.organizationsLede: Temples, churches, mosques, and other places of worship publishing here.
explore.heritageLede: Oral histories and family memory, preserved with provenance.
explore.religionTreeNote: Shown as a structure — religion, its traditions, and the sacred figures within them — for reference and research use. Presented plainly and respectfully across traditions, not as devotional or trivia content.

exploreAdmin.title: Explore sections
exploreAdmin.lede: Choose which dimensions appear on Explore, in what order, and the card art each one shows.
exploreAdmin.labelHint: Leave empty to use the built-in translation for this section.

exploreAdmin.imageHint: A path from this site's own uploads, beginning /media/.

exploreAdmin.iconHint: Shown in place of the built-in mark when there is no card image.

create.title: Create
create.lede: Publish articles, media, heritage, and more.
create.memberLede: Community members can read, follow, and participate in discussions.
create.memberTitle: Publishing isn't open to you yet
create.memberBody: Publishing devotional and heritage content requires authorization from a platform or sacred place administrator. Explore traditions and follow voices that matter to you.
create.publisherLede: Create devotional content within your authorized scope.
create.publishingContextHint: Choose whether this piece is published under your own name or on behalf of a sacred place you belong to.
create.studioNote: Authorization is enforced on the server.

create.summaryHint: A line or two shown in listings and previews. Optional.

create.linkInvalid: Only https:// and mailto: links are allowed.
create.tagsHint: Type # followed by a word anywhere in the article to tag it, e.g. #gratitude.
